maddeler.e:
أحقوقف (form XII)
# أَحْقَوْقِفُ (ʔaḥqawqifu) /ʔaħ.qaw.qi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# أَحْقَوْقِفَ (ʔaḥqawqifa) /ʔaħ.qaw.qi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# أَحْقَوْقِفْ (ʔaḥqawqif) /ʔaħ.qaw.qif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
